create_glmasr_processor: create a GlmAsr processor that wraps a feature extractor and tokenizer for automatic speech recognition
run_glmasr_transcription: run automatic speech transcription on audio input using GlmAsrProcessor.apply_transcription_request
create_glmasr_encoder: create a GlmAsr encoder with conv layers and transformer layers for audio feature extraction
create_glmasr_model: create a GlmAsrForConditionalGeneration model combining a Whisper encoder, multi-modal projector, and Llama language model
run_glmasr_generate: run text generation from audio input using GlmAsrForConditionalGeneration.generate
create_glmasr_attention: create a GlmAsrAttention module with rotary embeddings and configurable attention implementation
create_glmasr_mlp: create a GlmAsrMLP feedforward network with configurable hidden and intermediate sizes
create_glmasr_encoder_layer: create a GlmAsrEncoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and residual connections
